data.name: Raid

data.long_meaning: One who is a caller to Allah or to battle. The name Raid carries the meaning “Thunder” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Parents who choose Raid usually hope their child will grow to embody thunder and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A person who is constantly calling out to Allah for guidance and strength
data.etymology: Raid belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Thunder.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raid total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: رعد
in_arabic.long_meaning: رَعْدُ بالعربية تعني الرعد وهو صوت الصواعد والجبال وهو أحد أسماء الله تعالى في القرآن الكريم. ويستخدم اسم رعد في اللغة العربية لوصف الشخص الحازم والمستقيم والمنضبط. ويُعتبر اسم رعد من أسماء الله التي لها أهمية كبيرة في الإسلام، حيث يرمز للقوة والغضب، ويُنظر إليه على أنه أحد أسماء الله الحسنى.

in_urdu.name: رعد
in_urdu.meaning: اسم رعد کا مطلب ہے زبردست طوفان اور ہوا کی تیز رفتاری
in_urdu.long_meaning: اسم رعد کے معنی ہیں زبردست طوفان اور ہوا کی تیز رفتاری۔ جب خدا کا فرمان جاری ہوتا ہے تو اسے رعد کہا جاتا ہے، اور یہ نام اللہ کے اسماء الحسنہ میں سے ایک ہے۔ اس کے معنی میں قوت اور غصہ کا اظہار ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: रौद
in_hindi.meaning: रौद नाम का अर्थ है आकाश में उठने वाला बिजली का चमकना
in_hindi.long_meaning: रौद नाम का अर्थ है आकाश में उठने वाला बिजली का चमकना, जो प्रकृति की शक्ति का प्रतीक है। इस नाम की व्युत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है "रौद" या "रौदी"। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत लोकप्रिय है, क्योंकि यह नाम अल्लाह के नामों में से एक है, जो उनकी शक्ति और प्रबंधन को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: رعد
in_pashto.meaning: رعد نوموړی پښتني نوميړي د معنا دا ده چې ګونګېدونکي توپ ګړی
in_pashto.long_meaning: رعد په پښتو کې د ګونګېدونکي توپ ګړي معنی لري. په اسلامي روایتو کې د رعد نوم د الله تعالیٰ د نومونو څخه دي چې د قدرت او غضب د ښکارې په معنی دي. په افغانستان کې د رعد نوم په پښتو کې لوی ښکارې او پښتونو لپاره د قدرت او چاروښت د نوم په معنی دی.

in_english.name: Raid
in_english.meaning: Raid name means a sudden surprise attack or a strong and powerful storm
in_english.long_meaning: The Raid name is derived from the Arabic root ر-ع-د, which means "thunder" or "storm". It is one of the names of Allah in the Quran and is associated with the attribute of power and wrath. In Islamic tradition, Raid is considered a powerful and majestic name, symbolizing the strength and authority of Allah. It is a popular name among Muslim cultures and is often given to boys, as it is believed to bring them courage, strength, and protection.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Raid" in Islamic culture refers to a person who is a caller or an instigator, often in the context of summoning others to Allah or inciting them to join a righteous cause. In historical context, it is also used to describe Islamic military expeditions and raids carried out against non-Muslim enemies to spread the teachings of Islam and protect the Muslim community. Thus, the name "Raid" carries the connotation of courage, determination, and a strong sense of purpose in defending and spreading the faith.
data.spiritual_significance: For Muslims, the name "Raid" holds spiritual significance as it is connected to the idea of calling people to Allah and engaging in spiritual struggle. It is a reminder of the importance of advocating for one's faith and striving to reach the ultimate goal of pleasing Allah. The name can also serve as a source of motivation and inspiration for individuals to be steadfast in their beliefs and aspirations, and to never back down from the challenge of striving towards ethical and moral values. Overall, "Raid" represents a combination of personal and collective responsibility to spread the message of Islam and to uphold its values in the face of adversity.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Thunder" symbolizes One who is a caller to Allah or to battle. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Raid serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of thunder.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name "Raid" has gained popularity in the modern context of gaming, particularly in the realms of esports and online gaming. It refers to a multiplayer mission or instance in various games, where players band together to complete a challenging objective or defeat powerful enemies. Examples include "Raid" instances in popular MMORPGs (Massively Multiplayer Online Role-Playing Games) like "World of Warcraft" and "Destiny 2". The term is also used in console titles such as "Rainbow Six Siege" and "Tom Clancy's The Division", and in mobile games like "Clash of Clans". The general trend sees the continued development and refinement of raids as a core gameplay mechanic, driving player engagement, community building, and competitive esports scenes.
